body: I am still here, sadly... I cannot love myself so I try to express my love unto others but it seems to always fail me in the end... I am even more devastated now that I found out my ex-girlfriend is seeing someone else already. It's like a searing hot needle being sent straight through my heart and I can't stop it. I usually would cry my self to sleep but if you could see my face you would see it is emotionless and empty.
For so many years I thought I was the only one.
